# Vendored photo metadata reader

- exifr 7.1.3 (`full.umd.js`), MIT; license included.
- Upstream: https://github.com/MikeKovarik/exifr
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/exifr/-/exifr-7.1.3.tgz
- Used only to read GPS metadata from the locally selected background photo. No upload, device-location request, or external geolocation call.
